provenance.paper_title: VideoGen-of-Thought: Step-by-step generating multi-shot video with minimal manual intervention

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: IPP identity tokens; Latent boundary blends (FIFO of previous shot's last frame). Identity tokens reused per shot; boundary latent blended from the previous shot's last frame.

Boundary latents are blended and reset across shots (mutation by a fixed rule). For VideoGen-of-Thought, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of Identity-preserving (IPP) tokens.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 3): During inference, the operative memory component (Identity-preserving (IPP) tokens) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
